Maharashtra declares 85% areas drought-hit, announces farmer aid

Maharashtra has declared 85 percent of its areas as drought-hit, adding 40 talukas to the drought list. The state government announced that farmers in these regions will receive ₹5,000 each as aid before Diwali. The opposition has criticized the aid amount as inadequate.
